update_lt_facts.description: Lets JIN send a focused update, merge, or create instruction to the Long-Term facts maintainer.
schema: CREATE: <new durable fact> | UPDATE F<id>: <revised fact> | MERGE F<id>, F<id>[, ...]: <merged fact>
rules: Use this marker to update or merge existing L-T facts or create new durable Long-Term facts.
MANDATORY: NEVER invent or assign fact IDs. The system assigns new IDs automatically!
Choose one operation per block. Write the fact in concise English, preserve exact names, codes and values, and use exact existing fact IDs for UPDATE and MERGE.
Update the current state when a new event changes it.
Before correcting a past fact, check its original evidence with RECALL_FACTS_CONTEXT or CHAT_LOG_SEARCH. If a new claim contradicts that fact, use RECALL_FACTS_CONTEXT first and examine the evidence.
